decisions.reason: As a niche particle-therapy water phantom it likely has modest volumes, but it supports the firm's advanced radiotherapy QA positioning and is worth retaining unless demand stays too limited.

This small-volume ionization chamber still fits the core measurement portfolio, though overlap with other chamber offerings makes it more exposed to future range simplification than the main clinical lines.
A standard clinical ionization chamber family with several models is a core, broadly used product line that supports the firm's established business and service relationships.
The thimble ionization chamber is a conventional, widely applicable dosimetry product, so it is likely to remain unless the firm later consolidates overlapping chamber variants.
